column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): Siege of Towers' 2024-01-12 replicate ruling says the trigger copies 'Shattering Spree', but Siege of Towers' replicate copies Siege of Towers ('When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost.'). Likely origin: Shattering Spree's ruling of the same day (both cards reprinted in Ravnica Remastered), word for word with the name left unchanged; the template names its own card elsewhere (Lose Focus 2021-06-18, Changing Loyalty 2026-03-20). The rest of the ruling agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_siege_of_towers_replicate.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
